description: A silver multi-car train with lit windows runs on a curved elevated concrete guideway above a busy street with buses and older cars. Behind it are snow-capped mountains, harbour gantry cranes on the left, and high-rise towers on the right. A festival tent with bunting sits beside the track at right, and pedestrians stand on the street below. The painting is a dark, moody oil style and fills the whole image edge to edge. No readable text is visible.
